title: Residual-Driven Interaction Hypergraph
premise: pair-first decomposition for tractability; higher-order interactions are explicit residual terms, never assumed absent
state_equation: dS_i/dt = R_i + sum_j K_ij + sum_{j<k} K3_ijk + ... + B_i + C_i

interaction_orders.name: pair
interaction_orders.meaning: interface/contact/field/transport between two entities; default first interaction layer

interaction_orders.name: triplet
interaction_orders.meaning: irreducible three-entity coupling promoted only when pair reconstruction residual exceeds gate

interaction_orders.name: hyperedge
interaction_orders.meaning: bounded higher-order interaction or shared field/boundary condition

raphael_mapping.rule: normalize only physically/computationally derived pathway weights into closure/OBW/MMB
forbidden: equate TPW log well with chemical free energy
